classes.tooltip:
Captures every camera registered under CaptureGroupId in one call with a shared sequence number
and timestamp. While running, captures are triggered from this component's tick (TG_PostPhysics)
through FUBotSampleScheduler at UpdateRateHz, at most once per world tick; the first automatic
capture is due one interval after StartCaptureGroup.

Base class of the uBot cameras. Every sample renders the scene into the preview render target
(CaptureScene) and publishes a UUBotImageFrame that references it; pixels are read back to the CPU
only when a consumer calls UUBotImageFrame::RequestPixelReadback, and only while the frame is still
the latest capture (capture generation check).

Triggering: a camera without CaptureGroupId samples from the base component tick
(TG_PostPhysics, FUBotSampleScheduler) at UpdateRateHz. A camera with a CaptureGroupId never starts
on its own; the group's UUBotCameraCaptureCoordinatorComponent captures it through
CaptureSynchronized.

classes.tooltip:
Base class of every uBot sensor component. The component itself is the sensor frame and shows the
sensor model mesh.

Sampling: StartSensor takes one immediate sample, then the component tick (TG_PostPhysics) samples
whenever the FUBotSampleScheduler says a sample is due on the UpdateRateHz grid of uBot sim time.
At most one sample is taken per tick; due times skipped by long frames are counted by
GetDroppedSampleCount instead of being sampled in a burst with identical timestamps. The tick is
enabled only while the sensor runs, so subclasses must not clear PrimaryComponentTick.bCanEverTick.
SampleSensor can still be called directly at any time (manual or externally triggered sampling).
